question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obvious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Clear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obvious"** means something that is easily perceived or understood; clear, self-evident, or apparent. (स्पष्ट, साफ़)

 
 
• **Example: **It was obvious that she was upset about the news.
 
 
 
• **"Clear" **refers to something that is easy to perceive, understand, or interpret. (स्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were clear and easy to follow.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Obvious' **is **'Clear'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Clear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Murky **(धुंधला): Dark and gloomy, especially due to thick mist.

 
 
• **Example:** The water in the lake was murky and hard to see through.
 
 
 
• **Ambiguous **(अस्पष्ट): Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
 
 
• **Example: **The ending of the movie was ambiguous and left many viewers confused.
 
 
 
• **Opaque** (अस्पष्ट): Not able to be seen through; not transparent.
 
 
• **Example:** The windows were opaque with grime.
